items.title: ASML Plunged 17% Lower Over 3 Months: This Wall Street Desk Expects 88% Gains Over the Next 12
items.summary: ASML posted record revenue and still got hammered by sector-wide AI fears, with no company-specific bad news to blame. Why one bank sees far more upside than the consensus, and what could still derail the rebound, comes down to a few swing factors.

items.title: Can Applied Materials Capitalize on Rising HBM Demand in 2026?
items.summary: AMAT is poised to benefit from rising HBM demand, expanding DRAM capacity and advanced packaging, but its premium valuation raises questions.

items.title: Lam Research (LRCX) Stock Could Be 27% Overvalued Despite Fresh Buyback News

After a multi year run and fresh corporate actions, the key question is how well the stock price tracks the intrinsic value suggested by its cash flows. items.title: Renaissance Technologies Sold 99.7% Of Its $1.42 Billion Nvidia Stake Before Jensen Huang’s Exit, While Building A $1.62 Billion Stake In Another Chip Stock
items.summary: The same day Nvidia's CEO resigned, a quant giant's filing revealed it had quietly dumped nearly all its shares. The timing looks eerie, but the bigger story is where that money went instead.

items.title: Jim Cramer Says Lam Research Has Come Down Enough. It’s ‘Absolutely My Favorite’
items.summary: After a steep monthly slide, Cramer sees a bargain in the company that supplies the machines behind every AI chip. Record results and rising guidance back him up, but one China-sized risk could still derail the call.

items.title: Samsung’s $34 Billion HBM Bet Raises Memory Glut Risks
